stackDivergence.rationale: Task138 ports missing SvxPageItem default/copy/setters/equality and complete supported Any member behavior through actual PageStyleLayout and existing Any2Bool. Native Arabic/portrait/All/empty-name defaults, descriptor omission from copy/equality, byte/convert rules, unknown-member success and unsupported orientation resetting are retained. The existing browser noarg pooled-state contract projects four actual fields without a new native getter; full localization/numbering-provider services remain genuinely unported. All76published NumberingType constants and73original SvxNumType aliases reference one shared definition and are compared to pinned source at runtime; no numbering formatter is claimed. A single scoped prefer-literal-enum-member lint exception retains original IDL references without duplicating constants; repository lint configuration is unchanged. No custom string/allocator/lifetime engine, native build/generator/probe or ABI claim. SvxSetItem/SfxSetItem, real Calc DocPool/document/UI/ODS remain pending. Existing status/classification/history and deliberate I/O/recovery exceptions retained, no broad parity promotion.
